name: Passkey Proven-User Session Completion Proof
summary: Registers proof for the common proven-user adapters used after accepted Passkey proof: browser sign-in is established only for a durable proven user, and mobile tokens are minted only through the one-time-use-token bridge for that same durable user.
notes: These are common AuthenticationFlowService adapters shared by Passkey, TOTP and recovery-code proof paths. PasskeyController calls them only after EmailPasskeyAuthenticationService returns a proven AppUser.
The tests intentionally do not repeat WebAuthn proof; that security boundary is covered by passkey-sign-in.real-manager and passkey-sign-in service proof bindings.
Runtime execution evidence remains separate from this authored proof binding.

sourceReferences.note: Browser and token proven-user completion proof source.
CompleteProvenUserSessionAsync and CompleteProvenUserTokenAsync are the adapters under proof.
Email-bound Passkey complete endpoints invoke these adapters only after accepted Passkey proof returns the durable user.
